description:
## Payment Link
Create a shareable payment link (sent via WhatsApp/email/SMS) and query its stats.

> These are **portal APIs**: instead of a plain hash they require `merchant_auth` = base64 of the RSA-encrypted payload. Install node-forge or paste a pre-encrypted value into `{{pl_merchant_auth}}`.

request.description:
## Create Payment Link
RSA payload: `{ "mc_id": "...", "title": "...", "amount": "...", "currency": "...", "description": "...", "payment_limit": "...", "expired_date": "...", "return_url": "base64...", "merchant_ref_no": "...", "payout": Array|null }`
Hash: `request_time + merchant_id + merchant_auth`.

- `expired_date` format `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss`.
- `return_url` inside the RSA payload must be **base64-encoded**.
- Without node-forge, set `{{pl_merchant_auth}}` with the pre-encrypted payload.

```php
$data = json_encode($payload);
openssl_public_encrypt($data, $enc, $key, OPENSSL_PKCS1_PADDING);
$merchant_auth = base64_encode($enc);
```

## ⚡ Quick test
1. Run **Create Payment Link** first — its `payment_link_id` is auto-saved and consumed here.
2. RSA needed (node-forge or `{{pl_merchant_auth}}`); without it the test reports **SKIPPED**.

## Get Payment Link Details
RSA payload: `{ "mc_id": "...", "id": "..." }` (id = link id from Create).
Hash: `request_time + merchant_id + merchant_auth`.
Without node-forge, set `{{pl_merchant_auth}}`.
